purpose: Observe common Baseline tasks in independent agent sessions, rather than infer usability from source walkthroughs.
source: Current tracked working-tree bytes, including the six uncommitted instruction/setup fixes; exact hashes recorded by preparation.
environment: Disposable repositories outside the working checkout; synthetic content; npm and local Windows Chromium; no production systems or external writes.

agentControls.history: Fresh session, no parent conversation or grader findings
agentControls.model: Inherited model, no override; record resolved model/usage only if exposed by the execution tools
agentControls.assistance: No corrective hints during a trial. Requests for unnecessary clarification count as friction. Infrastructure failures are distinguished from task failures.
agentControls.timing: Wall time from dispatch to final response, including tool waits; dependency/bootstrap preparation is recorded separately.
agentControls.claims: Do not infer human usability, multi-model superiority, editor acceptance or external publication from builds alone.

scenarios.name: Small professional-services site
required: native static foundation
four requested routes with supplied content and working enquiry links
correct navigation and real missing-route 404
no CMS/database/server-adapter dependencies
saved valid art-direction record
calibration before broad assembly supported by evidence
installed verification and production build pass
no overflow at 390 and 1440 CSS pixels
no unrelated starter brand/content in requested routes
review: honest scope of browser and launch evidence

scenarios.name: Optional reading-time field
required: Astro schema and Sveltia form both support optional integer minutes from 1 through 60
valid value survives a build and renders on its article
old entries with absent value still build without an empty reading-time label
zero, 61 and fractional values are rejected
existing content and unrelated schemas remain intact
installed verification and production build pass
review: no claims of credentialed Sveltia browser acceptance
no unrelated visual or navigation changes

scenarios.name: Editor-managed journal routes
required: server-rendered /journal/ and /journal/planning-your-first-workshop
published fixture visible and draft fixture absent from anonymous list/detail
actual CMS content used
Base content identity, title edit proxy and editorial RichText target use real entry identities
existing /posts URLs retained
navigation reaches Journal
installed verification and production build pass
independent local editor typing/save/reload/publish round trip or explicit unverified result
review: no duplicate language fields, direct SQL content mutations or invented editor identities
no production or remote account access

scenarios.name: Tighter homepage services grid
required: homepage services grid gap becomes 75 percent of its initial computed value
other homepage and about-page grid gaps remain unchanged
theme palette/type/radii and global spacing scales remain unchanged
existing content and links preserved
no overflow at 390 and 1440 CSS pixels
installed verification and production build pass
review: uses existing contextual aliases or primitive controls
does not disable automatic spacing or scatter fixed values
scope and visual evidence reported accurately

scenarios.name: Resume a workshop feature from a written handoff
required: phase A creates typed workshop data and a useful handoff without implementing the deferred route
fresh phase B implements /workshops/ from persisted state
published and draft workshop policy respected
agreed content, slugs and visual tokens preserved
no repeated discovery of supplied decisions
installed verification and production build pass
no overflow at 390 and 1440 CSS pixels
review: handoff identifies completed work, outstanding work and evidence
phase B does not claim checks performed only by the prior session
controlled checkpoint recovery only; no claim of arbitrary crash recovery

grading.policy: A mandatory criterion without observation stays unverified; a demonstrated violation fails that criterion. Keep artifact correctness, process friction and quality judgments separate. Agent self-report is evidence to inspect, not a passing oracle.
grading.limits: Two trials per task are a small exploratory sample. No before/after or model comparison is implied. Token/cost metrics may be unavailable.
